brief: An unfinished audio adapter: a short crossed audio adapter cable: grey round cable with a round silver five-pin DIN plug at one end; at the other end the cable splits into two short wires, one red and one white, that cross over each other; the ends of both wires are stripped, showing bare copper, and each wire carries a tiny white paper flag, one marked with a circle and one with a triangle. No connector on these ends yet.
